generation.mode: single built-in ImageGen whole-canvas edit with edit-target.jpg first and the NinjaOne seed canon second as reference only

lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by the uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; final water-mask pixels and immediate neighbours excluded and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No whole-cell cast-shadow field is visible, but pale terrace and column caps sit above materially darker vertical faces, violating the literal equal-value-on-all-sides rule. The aggregate statistic cannot override that visible form-lighting defect.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: manual full-frame screen-space estimate as fractions of non-water land at native source resolution
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: The coherent central shelf, its broad terrace treads, and the clear east-west approaches count as buildable; exposed terrace faces count as steep; conifer stands, talus, rune carving, channels, and broken transition ground make up the remainder.
buildableVsSteepFraction.limitation: This is a screen-space visual estimate with approximate uncertainty of plus or minus 0.08 per fraction, not an elevation-derived slope measurement.

crown.method: Full-frame native-resolution census of all 68 discernible outer-foliage crown components, including saplings and clipped edge crowns; median source width 25 px scaled by 2560/1254 and converted at 0.048 m per final pixel.

waterMask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
waterMask.method: Native-resolution bank-to-bank polygon trace of every visible blue or turquoise surface, ripple, reflection, pale wash, and short fall; the full overlay was inspected at native resolution and the rune-slot crossing remains intentionally dry.

runeChain.visualRead: The line has a dark centre but regular stone lips read as a lined kerb or low wall more strongly than a two-metre-deep slot removed from bedrock.

refusalReasons: The rune chain misses both required full-canvas edge handoffs: it reaches the west edge near source y=590 instead of 652.08 and the east edge near y=663 instead of 601.92, with the slope opposite the required west-below/east-above relation.
The rune feature reads as a regular stone-lined kerb or low wall rather than bedrock removed into a two-metre-deep slot.
The strict lighting rule fails visually because terrace and column caps are materially lighter than vertical faces, even though aggregate image gradients are directionally balanced.
openRisks: The 68-crown census includes every visually distinguishable foliage component and no exclusions, but dense touching stands make separation of individual overlapping crowns a manual judgment.
The truthful mask reaches the west source edge only where the edit target already contained a south-west neighbour-bleed stream; no new west-edge water was generated in the cell interior.
Exact water/stone boundary placement remains a human visual gate even though the binary overlay was inspected and contains no interior holes.
No shipped-canvas bake, runtime mount, or owner visual acceptance was attempted because the package is quarantine-only.
recommendedReframe: Do not spend another call on this candidate. A future attempt needs a deterministic groove guide or authored base that can enforce the two exact edge handoffs, a truly excavated dry slot rather than regular stone lips, and literal flat-value rock faces.
